$schema: Fractal Factory modification — makes meta-knowledge gathering a mandatory universal feature of every produced agent system
description: Modifies the fractal factory itself so that every agent system it produces automatically includes a cross-run meta-knowledge gathering subsystem. This encodes the docwriter's proven knowledge-curator → signal-analyzer → knowledge-integrator pattern as a universal factory concern — like progress.json and manifest.json, every produced system gets meta/ infrastructure, Pass 0 (curation), a post-verification synthesis pass, and 5-7 meta-knowledge agents in its roster. The factory's domain-scanner, pipeline-architect, artifact-designer, roster-planner, routing-planner, prompt-writer, infra-writer, gap-hunter, and packager all learn the pattern.

factoryAgentTotal.note: Factory agent count stays the same — no new factory agents, only modifications to existing ones plus 2 reference documents

impactOnProducedSystems.additionalAgentsPerSystem: 5-7 (1 curator + 1 synthesis coordinator + 2 signal analyzers + 1 integrator + 0-2 domain-specific analyzers)

assumptions: The fractal factory's 28 agents and 7-pass pipeline exist as documented in .fractals/fractal-factory/agents/
The docwriter's meta-knowledge system (7 agents, Pass 0 + Pass 6.5) is the fully proven reference implementation
Factory agents read context.json, domain-model.json, architecture.json, roster.json — all existing artifact flow is stable
The factory already handles universal artifacts (progress.json, manifest.json, status.json) separately from domain-specific artifacts — meta-knowledge follows the universal pattern
Produced systems already have gap-hunting re-entry and convergence bounds — synthesis ties into this existing lifecycle

designDecisions.decision: Modify existing factory agents rather than adding new factory agents
designDecisions.rationale: Meta-knowledge is a cross-cutting concern that touches discovery, analysis, planning, execution, verification, and delivery. Adding a single 'meta-knowledge injector' agent would create an awkward bolt-on. Instead, each factory agent learns the pattern in its own domain — domain-scanner learns to add the meta-knowledge subdomain, pipeline-architect learns to add the passes, roster-planner learns to add the agents, etc. This keeps the factory's pure-phase architecture intact.

designDecisions.decision: Create a meta-knowledge reference architecture document (.fractal-factory/meta-knowledge-reference.md) that all factory agents reference
designDecisions.rationale: Rather than embedding the full meta-knowledge specification in each of 12 factory agents, create a single reference document. Factory agents reference it with 'See meta-knowledge-reference.md § X'. This follows the factory's existing pattern of reading context.json and architecture.json — adding one more reference is natural.

designDecisions.decision: Meta-knowledge agents in produced systems are domain-adaptive, not domain-agnostic
designDecisions.rationale: The signal analyzers and knowledge categories must be tailored to the domain. A doc-writer's signal analyzer extracts doc-writing patterns; a fiction-writer's extracts prose patterns. The factory's prompt-writer already customizes prompts by domain — it just needs to know the meta-knowledge role templates to fill in domain-specific content.

designDecisions.decision: Synthesis pass is positioned as a 'post-verification pre-delivery' pass in every produced system, not as a sub-step of verification
designDecisions.rationale: Signal extraction depends on verification outcomes (what passed, what failed, what needed multiple cycles). It must run after all writer→reviewer loops have completed. Making it a separate pass ensures clean lifecycle rather than complicating the existing verification coordinator.

designDecisions.decision: The domain-scanner injects a mandatory SD entry for meta-knowledge with 'factory-injected: true' flag
designDecisions.rationale: This distinguishes factory-mandated subdomains from user-described ones. The roster-planner can then treat factory-injected subdomains differently (always include, never merge away during budget trimming).

designDecisions.decision: Knowledge categories are derived from the domain during analysis, not hardcoded
designDecisions.rationale: Doc-writing, fiction-writing, code migration, and infrastructure planning all have different knowledge categories. The artifact-designer infers appropriate categories from the domain model — e.g., a code-migration domain would have 'migration-patterns', 'failure-modes', 'dependency-insights'. The reference document provides the universal skeleton; the artifact-designer fills in domain-specific categories.

tasks.title: Create meta-knowledge reference architecture document
tasks.description: Create .fractal-factory/meta-knowledge-reference.md — a comprehensive specification of the meta-knowledge subsystem that every produced system must include. Sections: § Universal Meta-Knowledge Architecture (Pass 0 lifecycle, synthesis pass lifecycle), § Agent Roles (curator, signal analyzers, integrator, synthesis coordinator), § Confidence Ladder (low→medium→high rules), § Quality Gate (reusability + actionability + non-redundancy), § Meta Directory Structure (meta/, knowledge-brief.json, synthesis-signals/), § Knowledge Category Derivation (how the factory infers domain-specific categories from domain-model.json), § Separation of Concerns (meta-knowledge vs. domain data). This document is READ by factory agents at Pass 2-4, not by produced agents.
acceptanceCriteria: Document covers all 7 sections listed in the description

§ Agent Roles defines the 5 universal meta-knowledge roles: knowledge-curator, craft-signal-analyzer (domain-specific name), context-signal-analyzer (domain-specific name), knowledge-integrator, synthesis-coordinator
§ Confidence Ladder specifies exact rules: new=low, 2-run confirm=medium, 3+ runs >80% acceptance=high, never skip levels
§ Quality Gate specifies the 3 mandatory criteria with pass/fail definitions
§ Knowledge Category Derivation describes how to infer 3-6 domain categories from domain-model.json subdomains and invariants
§ Meta Directory Structure defines: meta/index.json schema, meta/{category}/ entry format, synthesis-signals/ file format, meta/run-retrospectives/ schema
Document is self-contained — a factory agent can read it and know exactly what to produce without referencing external files

tasks.title: Create meta-knowledge agent prompt templates

Each template defines: the agent's standard sections, required clauses (confidence ladder, quality gate, cold-start handling), artifact contracts, and status contract. The prompt-writer fills in domain-specific content.

Knowledge-curator template includes: 4-factor relevance scoring section, cold-start handling section, knowledge-brief.json output contract

Knowledge-integrator template includes: confidence ladder enforcement section (exact rules), quality gate section, meta/ write rules, run retrospective output
Synthesis-coordinator template includes: sequential dispatch pattern, degraded mode handling
Each template marks domain-specific sections with clear {DOMAIN_SPECIFIC: ...} placeholders the prompt-writer fills per domain
